liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Song endings seem less like tape cutoffs than a rehearsal where a leader ends the tune by gesture [10]
- **Stealin'** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Stealin' as a reason to download the show, and rates the sound quality highly [12]
- **You Don't Love Me** (1 review): Reviewer praises this performance, noting Pigpen and Phil are strong, and laments the Allmans later running with the song [6]
- **Good Morning, Lil' School Girl** (1 review): Reviewer calls the bonus Schoolgirl outstanding and says Pigpen was in fine form [5]

## The recordings

- **gd66-02-25.sbd.unknown.1593.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 57 min; rated 4.77/5 by 52 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds sound excellent, with slight distortion on Jerry's vocal mic, unlike digital distortion; hiss appears when Schoolgirl begins, suggesting a different show; Recording quality is judged excellent for its vintage [4][5]
- **gd1966-02-25.sbd.unknown.20346.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 57 min; rated 4.24/5 by 17 [2]

## Around the show

- DeadBase assigned this material to 2/25 but marked the date of the list as uncertain [3]
- Reviewer notes DeadBase 10 lists no setlist for this date and suggests it sounds like a studio rehearsal [10]
- Gives the Ivar Theater's address as 1605 North Ivar Ave, Hollywood, and links to a history of the venue [11]
- Tom Waits's song 'Emotional Weather Report' mentions the Ivar Theater, comparing its ticket taker's smile on a Saturday night to cold [14]
- Reviewer says the performance and soundboard quality differ hugely from shows on 1/8, 3/12 and 3/25, doubting the early-year dating [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd66-02-25.sbd.unknown.1593.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master reel to DAT to CD transfer; the set is reportedly this date, possibly other 1966 material; May be listed as '??/??/66'; another shn set from tape 1-8 material circulates under that label [1]
- **gd1966-02-25.sbd.unknown.20346.sbeok.shnf**: source: MR>DATx>CD [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gdlistening.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead at the (possibly) Ivar Theater - 2/25/66](https://gdlistening.blogspot.com/2011/10/grateful-dead-at-possibly-ivar-theater.html) [16]
